activity.failing.text: Said once, here and in Needs you: at the second failure in a row or after two days; gone at its next good run.

activity.recent.text: The last day; the hourly re-checks and the usage reports, one line a kind.

signin.text: Run kranto open on the machine Kranto runs on and open the link it prints (it works for 10 minutes), or paste its code here. Agents never sign in here: they send their own token.

sources.topic.text: Items are compared with the topic before any model call; only those similar enough are judged. A source with no topic skips that and costs more.

models.gate.text: Items at or above this signal are kept. Each judge rates on its own scale, so the gate is saved with its model.

keys.model.text: Judging items, the scout and idea cards go through the provider chosen here: the Claude API, OpenRouter or another OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The key is tested with one request that runs no model.

sources.access.text: The labels say how: public, as any browser would read it; with an account you connect under Connections, read-only; or not offered, with the reason.

library.clusters.text: Themes of the latest map. A cluster's number means something within one map; its lineage follows it across maps.

rollups.text: Past their retention age, each week's observations are kept as one rollup.

news.text: A short brief per topic, off until you turn it on for one: what happened since the last brief, each item cited to an observation your watchers kept or a dated search result, never to the model's memory. One call a topic a day, at its hour.

ideas.score.text: The product of the card's five ratings.

library.movement.text: Excess: the change in share not explained by which sources were running. New: arrivals since the previous map against what the per-source rates predict; q is a one-sided binomial test corrected across this map's clusters.

grading.text: Card grades steer what ranks first: cards like one you graded useful rank higher, cards like one you graded not useful lower.

connections.text: Only read-only scopes are ever asked for; nothing is posted, starred, followed or changed.

updates.text: An update backs up, installs, restarts and checks itself, and rolls back on its own if the new version does not come up.

access.text: Every press, MCP tool and agent request carries a token; Kranto acts as that token's owner, whatever the request claims.

topics.sentence.text: Written for a reader who has never heard of it. Kranto match every item they read against this sentence.
